content:
sara_ml: Heads-up — proposing a small change to golden sampling + guardrails for new model bring-ups. Need a quick sync before we lock the eval set.

dan: tl;dr?

sara_ml: Add adversarial keyword filtering, tighten de-dupe fingerprint threshold for short prompts (<50 chars), reserve ~5% of the set for 'hard negatives' pulled from recent prod errors, and add a 'quant-susceptible' tag in example metadata.

raj_k: Agree. For de-dupe: current sim threshold 0.92 seems too strict for short contexts. Propose 0.88 for <50 chars and keep 0.92 otherwise.

anya: Where do we surface the hard negatives? Is that the 'recent-failures' cohort in the sample bank?

sara_ml: Yes. Plan: sampling mix becomes 70/25/5 (in-domain/holdout/hard-neg). Example SQL to pull hard negatives below (use as a starting point):

```sql
-- pull last 7 days errors flagged as 'model-failure' and with >=1 user-annotated-fail
SELECT id, text, fingerprint
FROM prod_events
WHERE event_type = 'model_failure'
  AND created_at >= now() - interval '7 days'
  AND user_flags @> ARRAY['annotated_fail']
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 5000;
```

dan: :thumbsup: Can labeling handle the extra guardrail rubric? We'll need checkbox fields: hallucination, toxic, pii exposure, format_break, and severity (low/med/high).

labeling-bot: New task created: ANNOT-GUARDRAIL-Q1. Link: https://redwood/tasks/ANN-12345

anya: I'll update the labeling docs and quick-start cheat sheet. Also suggest we add a 'quant-susceptible' flag for examples that flip between float16/int8 runs — that was useful in the last quant4b rollout.

sara_ml: Good call. We'll run a small "quant flip" test on a 2k subset and attach the delta metrics to example metadata (top-1 change, logit KL, edit-distance on outputs).

raj_k: Can infra schedule the flip tests on dedicated GPUs tomorrow? We want to compare logits and mark as fragile if top-1 diff > 0.2 or KL > 0.5.

sara_ml: I'll book a slot and post the job in #eng-ml. If infra is blocked, fallback to CPU-sim tests with the approximated kernels.

dan: I'll open the PR for the sampler changes (include unit tests for de-dupe thresholds and a small regression dataset). Will link the PR here when ready.

sara_ml: Thanks — follow-up sync at 11:30am PT. @labeling-bot please ping the labelers once the task is prefilled.

labeling-bot: Ping sent to @labelers.

(brief, actionable thread — agreed owners: dan -> sampler PR, anya -> labeling guide update, raj_k -> infra test slot, sara_ml -> overall coordination)
